title: Taulia pricing - Not publicly listed, third-party estimate of $100-$500
clean_text: Taulia does not publicly list pricing tiers; cost varies by customer needs and contract terms, requiring direct contact for a custom quote. One third-party aggregator (SelectHub) estimates pricing starting in the $100-$500 range, though this figure seems low relative to Taulia's positioning as an enterprise-scale, SAP-integrated supply chain finance platform and should be treated as a low-confidence estimate rather than a reliable rate. A free trial is reportedly available before committing to a paid plan.

meta.estimate_confidence: low - single aggregator source, inconsistent with enterprise positioning
